Clear photos of the DOT code or size markings on each tire to confirm size and model.
A statement or photo showing the vehicle or vehicle history that the tires were removed from, if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
